ab.title: Chicago Overlay - About
al.cd.h: minimum pause in seconds between repeats while the condition holds
al.h: fires when the threshold is crossed (then again only after it drops back); key = telemetry id (Sys.CpuTemp, Gpu.Temp…), voice = Windows speech voice, "quiet" = pause in seconds between repeats
dlg.intl: from abroad - card / GPay / APay / PayPal
dlg.qram: editing the amount regenerates the QR
err.webview2: WebView2 Runtime is missing - reinstall the app and keep the WebView2 Runtime component checked, or install it separately.
f.label: label
f.showHint: expr: v < 60 · v == 1 · d.Flag_Blue - empty = always
f.visHint: e.g. <60 hides at 60+ · =1 shows only at 1 · !=0 hides 0
fan.admin.h: motherboard fans and temperatures need admin rights - the app will restart (one UAC prompt)
fan.conflict: is running - it may overwrite values and hold controller access
fan.guard.h: watchdog process - when the app dies or freezes it restores fans to hardware-auto; it starts only while manual/curve writes are active, otherwise idle
fan.h: manual keeps a 20% floor; curve = % by temperature between two anchor points (flat outside, 4% hysteresis); everything returns to hardware-auto on critical temperature, HW source off, clean exit or app crash (watched by a guardian process)
fan.more: motherboard fans lack a control channel - they need the PawnIO driver (bundled with the installer) and admin rights; hit "rescan" after installing
fan.noPawn: PawnIO driver not found - motherboard fans and temperatures cannot be detected; it is bundled with the installer (or pawnio.eu)
fan.none: no controllable channels - enable the HW sensors aux source (GPU/HW) on the Sources tab
fan.on.h: turning off restores fans to hardware-auto and blocks all writes - the tray menu has the same toggle
h.adjust: handles on the current area - edges/corners resize, inside moves; Enter or double-click confirms, Esc cancels
h.after: text right after the element's edge · bulk-applies to the selection
h.anchor: screen anchor tl·c·br - position holds on any resolution
h.auto: state bounds from value history; off = manual lo/hi
h.bgEl: element background - texts: band behind glyphs · bar: track
h.bgNew: background template for NEW elements (existing keep theirs)
h.borderS: line style: solid/dashed/dotted; outset/inset = relief frame
h.btnBox: adds a box/panel - border, fill, custom text
h.btnData: adds a data element - telemetry value
h.btnFlag: adds a flag - lights only for its type
h.btnGraph: adds a graph - value history over time
h.btnLock: edit mode - drag and pick elements
h.btnSave: saves the HUD under the typed name
h.btnSector: adds sectors S1/S2/S3 side by side
h.cMid: color when value in lo-hi band
h.clip: long text clips at the element cell (…) instead of spilling over
h.colorNeg: negative-side color for orient c (delta loss)
h.conv: value conversion - auto detects type from prop (Temp→°F, kmh→mph); zone thresholds stay in source units
h.cross: edit-mode crosshair: center cross / full-screen lines
h.digits: fixed digit count (0 = auto) - stable width on 99→100
h.fill: solid single color · sharp hard zones · gradient smooth blend · spectrum hue-wheel sweep - all from color/color2/color3
h.glow: fill glow radius in px (0 = off)
h.gmajor: bold line every N px - always lands exactly on a grid line
h.grid: grid step - element move and x/y spinner
h.gxor: dims the scene under the edit grid - light lines and outlines always readable
h.gxorBg: dim color - a light color flips grid and outlines dark
h.id: unique element name - tells same-type elements apart (rpm_1 / rpm_2)
h.label: small caption above the element · applies to the whole multi-selection
h.layoutName: filename to save under - new name = new layout
h.layoutPick: pick a saved HUD - switches the layout
h.marquee: text wider than the cell scrolls right-to-left like a car radio (RDS)
h.maxGraph: axis high - empty = auto from history
h.minGraph: axis low - empty = auto from history
h.mono: tabular digits - number does not shift on width change
h.offMode: off state: dim fades · hide removes completely
h.on: expression over prop - empty = truthy · e.g. v > 0
h.orient: h horizontal · v vertical · c centered (±delta)
h.owidth: dashed element outline width in edit mode
h.pad: background pad around glyphs - 0 tight · empty auto
h.pickcanvas: canvas area (overlay window) - edges crop, inside moves it as one; Enter/double-click confirms, Esc cancels
h.prop: telemetry - group filter above the dropdown; custom key works too
h.refl: mirror reflection below the bar, distance px (0 = off)
h.rules: when expr → color/blink/hide - first match wins
h.seg: draw fill as LED segments with gaps
h.segGap: gap width between segments in px
h.segSnap: quantize fill to whole cells (LED meter)
h.spread: +/− also scales selection spacing (group zoom); off = each element grows in place
h.stPaint: state colors target: bg band behind · text itself
h.textFont: font for units and non-seg7 texts
h.type: value · bar · graph · box panel · flag · sector · lap
h.unit: unit after the number - km/h, °C, bar…
h.z1: zone edge 1 as % of scale (low → mid)
h.z2: zone edge 2 as % of scale (mid → peak)
insp.title: Chicago Overlay - Inspector
plugin.busy: SimHub is running and holds the plugin loaded - close SimHub and try again.
plugin.nofile: Chicago.Bridge.dll not found next to the app (plugin folder).
plugin.restart: SimHub is running - restart it so the plugin loads.
prof.h: process (.exe optional) or SimHub game name (partial match) → monitor → layout; "HUD off" hides that monitor; everything reverts when the game exits
set.accent: auto from Windows - changes apply live
set.bak.h: backups are stored in data\layout_backup and data\lang_backup
set.canvas.h: x/y/w/h area (px) - x/y is the offset from the monitor's top-left corner, kept inside it; elements outside are hidden; moving the area moves the HUD as one
set.custom.h: single renderer in a bounded area - drag to outline it; may cut across monitors
set.eco.h: passive HUD gets data slower (~5 Hz) - saves renderer CPU/GPU
set.files.h: sharing = copy a .json file here; a new layout / language appears in the menus
set.hubtick.h: how often the plugin polls telemetry - free SimHub ~10 Hz, licensed up to 60 Hz
set.impFail: import failed - file cannot be read
set.lang.h: more languages = <code>.json file in data\lang folder (e.g. de.json)
set.scale.h: enlarges app windows and menus; HUD layouts are unaffected
set.shared.h: single renderer for all monitors - lowest RAM; elements stay on their monitor
set.split.h: each monitor = own WebView - isolation, ~140 MB per monitor
set.tick.h: data rate to all monitor views - a monitor can override it; unrelated to the SimHub tick (see Sources); edited view always runs full speed
set.title: Chicago Overlay - Settings
set.units.h: applies to app temperatures and HUD elements with "auto" conversion; an element can override it in the inspector; zone and alert thresholds are entered in source units
set.zomb.h: an orphaned chromium renderer (after a force-kill/crash) burns CPU and chokes the HUD - the watchdog detects and kills it; only touches this app's processes
sys.vendorSw: vendor software running - may block usb controller readings
upd.done: launching installer - the app will close
sys.hw.none: no hardware detected - enable gpu aux source
hwi.title: Chicago Overlay - HW info
hwi.head: detected hardware
